sprint_goal: The review, retro, lessons, drive, report and verify scripts lose 28 Medium bugs; each fix's test fails without it

seats.achievable: yes - all 28 units are groomed Medium bugs (72 points) with executable Verify lines, and every named test file is still absent, so each fix is written test first. The risk is sequencing, not scope: BG0970, BG0982, BG0999, BG1050, BG1108, BG1120, BG1124, BG1125, BG1229, BG1265, BG1492, BG1625 and BG1628 all edit critic.py, and the other fifteen share sprint.py, retro, lessons and verify_ac. Both clusters must run serially or in rebased lanes.
seats.done_means: Each of the 28 Medium bugs in the critic, retro, lessons, drive, report and verify scripts is Fixed with its pinning test green and shown red on the unfixed code, serving O1 (verified criteria), O3 (autonomous sprint) and O5 (fix the code path, small process).
seats.one_increment: yes - every unit is a defect in the sprint tooling's own review, retro, lessons, drive, report or verify path, so the batch reads as one hardening increment on the sprint machinery. The two clusters touch different scripts but share the same goal.
seats.note: 1) critic.py is hit by 13 units (BG0970, BG0982, BG0999, BG1050, BG1108, BG1120, BG1124, BG1125, BG1229, BG1265, BG1492, BG1625, BG1628), so expect merge conflicts and brief ordering matters; BG0970/BG0982/BG1125 all change the brief diff scope and could be one coherent change. 2) BG1229 packs three behaviours (TRUE ruling, record --dry-run, underscore escape) into one AC at 3 points, and the underscore part overlaps BG1628, so its Verify is a whole file and may pass without proving each. 3) BG1532 (5 pts) has an AC2 sweep over all write_text sites in the scripts; the number of offenders is unmeasured and could grow beyond 5 points. It also edits five scripts plus trd.md. 4) BG1475 (3 pts) bundles a staleness batching change in review_prep.py with close progress output in sprint.py and lists gate.py: tight. 5) BG1534 AC3 repairs TS0002 so ts-check reads clean; that is legitimate only if the rows are corrected rather than the check loosened. 6) Verify lines that name a whole class or file (BG1229, BG1578, BG1625, BG1628, BG1623, BG1626, BG1436) need each test to fail without the fix; BG1623 and BG1625 criteria already state 'Fails on', the others should be checked in review. 7) BG1578, BG1623, BG1625, BG1626 and BG1628 have uncommitted edits (re-sizing and new ACs); commit them before the plan is signed. 8) The goal text names no outcome; serves O1/O3/O5.

clauses.The review, retro, lessons, drive, repor: yes - 28 units listed, all Medium, each with a Verify line: critic.py (BG0970, BG0982, BG0999, BG1050, BG1108, BG1120, BG1124, BG1125, BG1229, BG1265, BG1492, BG1625, BG1628), retro (BG1059, BG1060, BG1332, BG1463, BG1465), lessons (BG1436, BG1482, BG1483), drive (BG1623, BG1626), report (BG1532, BG1012, BG1475), verify (BG1534, BG1578). Missing: nothing structural; BG1532's sweep size and the critic.py conflict load are the delivery risks.
clauses.each fix's test fails without it: partial - almost every unit names a specific test, many with explicit 'Fails on' wording (BG1532, BG1534, BG1475, BG1623, BG1625), and BG1532 AC3 plants a defect to prove its sweep can fail. But no criterion requires red-before-green evidence, and BG1229, BG1578, BG1628, BG1436 and BG1626 point at whole files or classes, so a test that cannot fail could pass. The reviewer must run each Verify against the unfixed code (git stash of the fix) to confirm.

seats.achievable: yes - all 28 units are groomed Medium bugs with Verify lines on named tests (about 70 points); the goal can be reached if the larger units BG1625, BG1532, BG1623 (5 points each) and the two shared-file clusters are sequenced, and the Fixed count of 28 is the only measure.
seats.done_means: All 28 named Medium bugs are Fixed, each with a test that runs red before and green after, so the critic/review, retro, lessons, drive, report and verify tooling stops misleading Maya Okafor (End goals 1 and 3: shipped means verified, autonomous drive) and the process stays honest (O5, End goal 5); the goal as written names no outcome, so this reading should be recorded.
seats.one_increment: yes - mostly: 13 units are critic.py brief/record/self-check, 8 are retro/lessons, and the rest are drive, report and verify; all repair the review-and-close machinery one operator runs, so they hang together as 'the sprint tooling stops giving wrong answers'. Not a user-facing feature increment.
seats.note: Product concerns. (1) The goal names no PRD outcome or persona; it serves Maya End goals 1, 3 and 5 and Rowan End goal 4 only indirectly. Record that. (2) Roughly 70 points exceeds the 50-point-in-five-hours norm in memory, and cost per point is the operator's top concern; BG1532 (5 points, a repo-wide write_text sweep plus TRD edit across every script) and BG1625 (5) are the likely overruns and could be split. (3) Scope leaks beyond the named scripts: BG1265 is an agent definition and brief text, BG1492 adds a pre-commit lane, BG1532 touches the TRD and all scripts, BG1578 touches tools/verify-corpus.sh and a time budget in US0926; the goal wording 'scripts' undersells them. (4) BG1534 AC3 is a shell grep over a test spec, not a test that fails without the fix in the usual sense; it does fail today, so acceptable. (5) BG1265 AC1 tests prose in an agent definition, which proves a sentence exists not that a reviewer behaves; AC3 does cover behaviour. (6) BG1628 AC2 removes the MD037 disable, a good guard against an interim. (7) Of the 18 distinct test files the Verify lines name, only test_retro_seat_misses.py exists yet, so every red-before check depends on the builder writing the test first; the pre-fix failing run must be recorded per unit.

clauses.The review, retro, lessons, drive, repor: partial - 28 units are in the batch and all are Medium (BG0970, BG0982, BG0999, BG1050, BG1108, BG1120, BG1124, BG1125, BG1229, BG1625, BG1628 critic review; BG1012, BG1623, BG1626 report and drive; BG1059, BG1060, BG1332, BG1463, BG1465 retro; BG1436, BG1482, BG1483 lessons; BG1534, BG1578 verify). But BG1265 (agent definition), BG1492 (pre-commit hook), BG1475 (review_prep and sprint close) and BG1532 (TRD plus all scripts) reach past the six named script families, so the clause is true of the count, loosely true of the families.
clauses.each fix's test fails without it: yes - every unit carries Verify lines naming a specific test, and most ACs state 'Fails on:' the defect (BG1332, BG1463, BG1465, BG1475, BG1482, BG1483, BG1492, BG1532, BG1534). Missing: BG0970, BG0982, BG1050, BG1108, BG1120, BG1124, BG1125, BG1229, BG1625, BG1628 and the rest do not all state the failing-without-fix condition, and 17 of 18 named test files do not yet exist, so the red-before-fix run must be evidenced at build; BG1534 AC3 and BG1265 AC1 are a grep and a prose check rather than behavioural tests.

seats.achievable: yes - all 28 units are groomed Mediums at 2-5 points with executable Verify lines, so the batch can reach Fixed; the risk is serial throughput, not scope: 13 units (BG0970, BG0982, BG0999, BG1050, BG1108, BG1120, BG1124, BG1125, BG1229, BG1265, BG1492, BG1625, BG1628) all edit critic.py and 15 more (BG1012, BG1059, BG1060, BG1332, BG1436, BG1463, BG1465, BG1475, BG1482, BG1483, BG1532, BG1534, BG1578, BG1623, BG1626) share the retro, lessons, sprint, drive and verify_ac cluster.
seats.done_means: Done means each of the 28 Medium bugs is Fixed with its Verify lines green from the oracle, and each fix's test reproduces the defect when the fix is reverted, serving O1 and O5 (a verified fix in the code path, and Maya Okafor's end goals 2 and 5).
seats.one_increment: yes - every unit is a defect in a review-adjacent script (critic, retro, lessons, sprint report, drive, verify_ac), so they read as one 'fix the review and run-close tooling' increment, though it is two shared-file clusters that must be landed serially.
seats.note: (1) The failing-without-the-fix property is stated outright in only some ACs (BG1578, BG1532, BG1475, BG1265 carry 'Fails on:'); BG0970, BG0999, BG1050, BG1108, BG1120, BG1124, BG1125, BG1332, BG1436, BG1482 and BG1483 rely on a test name alone, so the self-check and reviewer mutation pass must supply the revert-and-fail evidence. (2) BG1229 packs three separate claims (TRUE ruling, --dry-run, asterisk/underscore row) into one AC whose Verify is the whole test file, so one weak test could hide behind a green file; BG1628 overlaps its markdown-escape claim, so check they do not double-count. (3) BG1534's third Verify is a grep of a count line (0 findings) which can pass vacuously once rows are edited rather than the checker fixed; its positive/negative pair in AC1/AC2 is what proves it. (4) BG1578 AC2 asserts a runner-speed-scaled time budget, a timing property that is easy to make green by widening the budget rather than measuring; the test must fail on a fixed budget. (5) 5-point units BG1532, BG1623 and BG1625 each have 3-4 ACs spanning code, a sweep and TRD text, and look tight; BG1532's repo-wide write_text sweep may expose further writers and balloon. (6) The test files named in the Verify lines do not exist yet (for example test_brief_uncommitted_affects.py, test_corpus_verify_red_detail.py, test_drive_step_accept_resume.py), so every ACs is verified only after authoring; none can be called green now. (7) The goal names no PRD outcome; it serves O1 and O5 and Maya Okafor's end goals 2 and 5, and indirectly O12 via the retro and lessons fixes (BG1332, BG1436, BG1463, BG1482, BG1483).

clauses.The review, retro, lessons, drive, repor: yes - 28 units are listed, all Medium, spanning critic.py (BG0970, BG0982, BG0999, BG1050, BG1108, BG1120, BG1124, BG1125, BG1229, BG1265, BG1492, BG1625, BG1628), retro (BG1059, BG1060, BG1332, BG1463, BG1465), lessons (BG1436, BG1482, BG1483), report (BG1012, BG1532), drive (BG1623, BG1626), verify (BG1534, BG1578) and review_prep/close (BG1475); nothing missing except that the count is only true once every one reaches Fixed, and BG1532 and BG1625 may need follow-on bugs.
clauses.each fix's test fails without it: partial - every unit has an executable Verify naming a test, and BG1578, BG1532, BG1475, BG1265 and BG1625-style units state 'Fails on:' for the defect, but most others (BG0970, BG0999, BG1050, BG1108, BG1120, BG1124, BG1125, BG1332, BG1436, BG1482, BG1483, BG1626) state no revert-and-fail check, and BG1229 and BG1534's shell Verify can pass vacuously; the gap is closed only if each unit's self-check and review mutation pass record the test failing with the fix reverted.
